name: genre-minidv-camcorder
description: Use when rendering early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder footage: small-sensor digital video, body-driven handheld motion with inertia, imperfect reactive framing, occasional optical rocker zoom, built-in mic. Do NOT use for VHS home video (genre-vhs-domestic), 35mm film, gimbal-smooth or tripod-stable camera, drone shots, or mechanical/perfect tracking; those read as wrong.
